You
Runway holding position marking on B: stop at the solid lines unless cleared
Mandatory sign 9-27 (white on red) with location sign B (yellow on black)
Runway boundary sign: faces the runway, for pilots exiting; clear once past it
Enhanced centerline: the hold is coming
ILS critical area hold (ladder) with ILS sign: farther back than the runway hold
Direction array before B: turn left for B; you are on A
Painted direction sign: yellow with black, left of the centerline for a left turn
Hold short of a taxiway: single dashed line across A
Continuous double edge: pavement beyond is not for aircraft
Dashed double edge: the pavement beyond (here, the apron) is usable
Nonmovement boundary: dashed side toward the movement area, solid on the ramp
Runway hold on C, closer to the runway than the ILS hold
